# /usr/lib/systemd/system/sv08-recovery-display.service
[Unit]
Description=SV08 local recovery interface
After=systemd-udev-settle.service
Conflicts=getty@tty1.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/sv08-recovery-image

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/xinit /usr/bin/python3 /usr/lib/sv08/sv08_recovery_ui.py -- :0 vt1 -nolisten tcp
StandardInput=tty
TTYPath=/dev/tty1
TTYReset=yes
TTYVHangup=yes
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# /etc/systemd/system/sv08-recovery-display.service.d/independent.conf
[Unit]
Wants=systemd-udev-settle.service
ConditionPathExists=/run/sv08/recovery-verified
[Service]
Environment=HOME=/run/recovery-home
Environment=LANG=C.UTF-8
Environment=PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
Environment=LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1
Environment=XDG_CACHE_HOME=/run/recovery-home/cache
